system.longDesc: You can block, deflect, and shield against psychic influences.
system.requirement: Power talent: Willpower (Shielding) power focus at Expert

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Shielding effect. You also gain the power focus Willpower (Shielding).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Shielding effect. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Shielding effects for –1 SP.
